LECTURE 43 Stage 6: Fine-tuning & Deployment

Stage 6 Capstone — Complete Fine-tuned LLM System

The Grand Finale: Pretrained Model + Instruction Fine-tuning + LoRA + RAG in One Working System
60 min read Capstone The culmination of 43 lectures

Introduction: The Moment Everything Comes Together

You have arrived at the final lecture of the main course. Forty-three lectures ago, you asked: “What is a language model?” Now you will assemble a complete, working LLM system from every component you built:

  • Stages 1–2: Tokenization, embeddings, positional encodings
  • Stage 3: Attention mechanisms — the core of Transformers
  • Stage 4: Complete GPT-2 architecture
  • Stage 5: Training pipeline — loss, optimizer, scheduling
  • Stage 6: Fine-tuning, LoRA, RAG, quantization, domain specialization

In this capstone, you integrate all of it into a single pipeline: query in, RAG retrieval, model inference with LoRA adapters, response generation, quality evaluation. Not a diagram. A working system.

What Makes This Capstone Special: Every class, every function, every matrix multiplication connects back to a previous lecture. There are no black boxes left.

Part 1: System Architecture

The Complete LLM Pipeline

ComponentStageRole
Tokenizer2Text to token IDs and back
GPT-2 Model3–5Transformer next-token prediction
LoRA Adapters6Lightweight fine-tuning
RAG Retriever6External knowledge retrieval
Evaluation Suite5–6Multi-dimensional quality scoring

The data flow: user query → RAG retrieval → context augmentation → tokenization → model + LoRA forward pass → autoregressive generation → evaluation.

Part 2: Assembling All Components

Python — Assembling the Full LLM Pipeline 

import numpy as np
np.random.seed(42)

# === TOKENIZER (Stage 2) ===
class Tokenizer:
 def __init__(self):
 chars = sorted(set('abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789 .,!?;:\\'-\
"()[]'))
 self.stoi = {c:i+1 for i,c in enumerate(chars)}
 self.stoi[''] = 0
 self.itos = {i:c for c,i in self.stoi.items()}
 self.vocab_size = len(self.stoi)
 def encode(self, text, ml=None):
 ids = [self.stoi.get(c,0) for c in text]
 if ml: ids = ids[:ml]; ids += [0]*(ml-len(ids))
 return ids
 def decode(self, ids):
 return ''.join(self.itos.get(i,'?') for i in ids if i!=0)

# === CORE MATH (Stages 3-4) ===
def softmax(x, axis=-1):
 e = np.exp(x - np.max(x, axis=axis, keepdims=True))
 return e / (e.sum(axis=axis, keepdims=True) + 1e-8)

def layer_norm(x, g, b, eps=1e-5):
 m = x.mean(-1, keepdims=True); v = x.var(-1, keepdims=True)
 return g * (x - m) / np.sqrt(v + eps) + b

def gelu(x):
 return 0.5 * x * (1 + np.tanh(np.sqrt(2/np.pi) * (x + 0.044715*x**3)))

# === LoRA ADAPTER (Stage 6) ===
class LoRA:
 def __init__(self, d, rank=4, alpha=8):
 self.A = np.random.randn(d, rank)*0.01
 self.B = np.zeros((rank, d))
 self.s = alpha/rank
 def forward(self, x): return x @ self.A @ self.B * self.s
 def params(self): return self.A.size + self.B.size

# === TRANSFORMER BLOCK (Stage 4) ===
class Block:
 def __init__(self, d, nh):
 s=0.02; self.d=d; self.nh=nh; self.dk=d//nh
 self.Wq=np.random.randn(d,d)*s; self.Wk=np.random.randn(d,d)*s
 self.Wv=np.random.randn(d,d)*s; self.Wo=np.random.randn(d,d)*s
 ff=d*4
 self.W1=np.random.randn(d,ff)*s; self.b1=np.zeros(ff)
 self.W2=np.random.randn(ff,d)*s; self.b2=np.zeros(d)
 self.g1=np.ones(d); self.bb1=np.zeros(d)
 self.g2=np.ones(d); self.bb2=np.zeros(d)
 self.lora_q = LoRA(d); self.lora_v = LoRA(d)

 def forward(self, x):
 B,T,D = x.shape
 h = layer_norm(x, self.g1, self.bb1)
 Q = h@self.Wq + self.lora_q.forward(h)
 K = h@self.Wk
 V = h@self.Wv + self.lora_v.forward(h)
 Q=Q.reshape(B,T,self.nh,self.dk).transpose(0,2,1,3)
 K=K.reshape(B,T,self.nh,self.dk).transpose(0,2,1,3)
 V=V.reshape(B,T,self.nh,self.dk).transpose(0,2,1,3)
 sc = Q@K.transpose(0,1,3,2)/np.sqrt(self.dk)
 sc += np.triu(np.ones((T,T))*-1e9, k=1)
 o = (softmax(sc)@V).transpose(0,2,1,3).reshape(B,T,D)
 x = x + o@self.Wo
 h2 = layer_norm(x, self.g2, self.bb2)
 x = x + gelu(h2@self.W1+self.b1)@self.W2+self.b2
 return x

# === GPT-2 MODEL (Stage 4) ===
class MiniGPT2:
 def __init__(self, V, d=48, nh=4, nl=3, ml=48):
 self.d=d; self.ml=ml; self.V=V
 self.te = np.random.randn(V,d)*0.02
 self.pe = np.random.randn(ml,d)*0.02
 self.blocks = [Block(d,nh) for _ in range(nl)]
 self.gf=np.ones(d); self.bf=np.zeros(d)
 self.head = np.random.randn(d,V)*0.02
 def forward(self, ids):
 B,T = ids.shape
 x = self.te[ids] + self.pe[:T][None]
 for b in self.blocks: x = b.forward(x)
 return layer_norm(x, self.gf, self.bf) @ self.head
 def count_params(self):
 t = self.te.size + self.pe.size + self.gf.size + self.bf.size + self.head.size
 for b in self.blocks:
 t += sum(w.size for w in [b.Wq,b.Wk,b.Wv,b.Wo,b.W1,b.b1,b.W2,b.b2,
 b.g1,b.bb1,b.g2,b.bb2])
 t += b.lora_q.params() + b.lora_v.params()
 return t

# === Instantiate and verify ===
tok = Tokenizer()
model = MiniGPT2(tok.vocab_size)

print("=" * 55)
print("COMPLETE LLM SYSTEM - COMPONENT ASSEMBLY")
print("=" * 55)
print(f"\
[1] Tokenizer: vocab={tok.vocab_size}")
test = "Hello, world!"
enc = tok.encode(test, ml=16)
print(f" '{test}' -> {enc[:len(test)]} -> '{tok.decode(enc[:len(test)])}'")

print(f"\
[2] GPT-2 Model: {model.count_params():,} params")
print(f" d={model.d}, heads=4, layers=3, max_len={model.ml}")
logits = model.forward(np.array([enc]))
print(f" Forward: (1,16) -> logits {logits.shape}")
print(f" Range: [{logits.min():.3f}, {logits.max():.3f}]")

lora_p = sum(b.lora_q.params()+b.lora_v.params() for b in model.blocks)
print(f"\
[3] LoRA Adapters: {lora_p:,} params attached")
print(f"\
[OK] All core components verified!")

Part 3: RAG Retriever + End-to-End Generation

Now we add the RAG retriever and wire everything into a complete generation pipeline. A user query triggers retrieval, context augmentation, and autoregressive decoding.

Why Both LoRA and RAG?

  • LoRA encodes skill — how to reason, what patterns to follow. Baked into weights.
  • RAG provides knowledge — specific facts and up-to-date information. Retrieved at query time.

Together: the ability (LoRA) and the information (RAG) for expert responses.

Python — End-to-End RAG + LoRA Generation 

import numpy as np
np.random.seed(42)

# --- Minimal rebuilds (self-contained cell) ---
def softmax(x, axis=-1):
 e=np.exp(x-np.max(x,axis=axis,keepdims=True)); return e/(e.sum(axis=axis,keepdims=True)+1e-8)
def layer_norm(x,g,b,eps=1e-5):
 return g*(x-x.mean(-1,keepdims=True))/np.sqrt(x.var(-1,keepdims=True)+eps)+b
def gelu(x): return 0.5*x*(1+np.tanh(np.sqrt(2/np.pi)*(x+0.044715*x**3)))

class T:
 def __init__(self):
 cs=sorted(set('abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789 .,!?;:\\'-\
"()[]'))
 self.stoi={c:i+1 for i,c in enumerate(cs)};self.stoi['']=0
 self.itos={i:c for c,i in self.stoi.items()};self.vocab_size=len(self.stoi)
 def encode(self,t,ml=None):
 ids=[self.stoi.get(c,0) for c in t]
 if ml:ids=ids[:ml];ids+=[0]*(ml-len(ids))
 return ids
 def decode(self,ids): return ''.join(self.itos.get(i,'?') for i in ids if i!=0)

class L:
 def __init__(self,d,r=4,a=8): self.A=np.random.randn(d,r)*0.01;self.B=np.zeros((r,d));self.s=a/r
 def forward(self,x): return x@self.A@self.B*self.s

class BK:
 def __init__(self,d,nh):
 s=0.02;self.d=d;self.nh=nh;self.dk=d//nh
 self.Wq=np.random.randn(d,d)*s;self.Wk=np.random.randn(d,d)*s
 self.Wv=np.random.randn(d,d)*s;self.Wo=np.random.randn(d,d)*s
 ff=d*4;self.W1=np.random.randn(d,ff)*s;self.b1=np.zeros(ff)
 self.W2=np.random.randn(ff,d)*s;self.b2=np.zeros(d)
 self.g1=np.ones(d);self.p1=np.zeros(d);self.g2=np.ones(d);self.p2=np.zeros(d)
 self.lq=L(d);self.lv=L(d)
 def forward(self,x):
 B,T,D=x.shape;h=layer_norm(x,self.g1,self.p1)
 Q=h@self.Wq+self.lq.forward(h);K=h@self.Wk;V=h@self.Wv+self.lv.forward(h)
 Q=Q.reshape(B,T,self.nh,self.dk).transpose(0,2,1,3)
 K=K.reshape(B,T,self.nh,self.dk).transpose(0,2,1,3)
 V=V.reshape(B,T,self.nh,self.dk).transpose(0,2,1,3)
 sc=Q@K.transpose(0,1,3,2)/np.sqrt(self.dk)
 sc+=np.triu(np.ones((T,T))*-1e9,k=1)
 o=(softmax(sc)@V).transpose(0,2,1,3).reshape(B,T,D)
 x=x+o@self.Wo;h2=layer_norm(x,self.g2,self.p2)
 return x+gelu(h2@self.W1+self.b1)@self.W2+self.b2

class G:
 def __init__(self,V,d=48,nh=4,nl=3,ml=48):
 self.d=d;self.ml=ml;self.V=V
 self.te=np.random.randn(V,d)*0.02;self.pe=np.random.randn(ml,d)*0.02
 self.blocks=[BK(d,nh) for _ in range(nl)]
 self.gf=np.ones(d);self.bf=np.zeros(d);self.head=np.random.randn(d,V)*0.02
 def forward(self,ids):
 B,T_=ids.shape;x=self.te[ids]+self.pe[:T_][None]
 for b in self.blocks:x=b.forward(x)
 return layer_norm(x,self.gf,self.bf)@self.head

# === RAG KNOWLEDGE BASE ===
class KnowledgeBase:
 def __init__(self, d=48):
 self.d=d; self.docs=[]; self.embs=[]
 def add(self, text):
 e=np.zeros(self.d)
 for i,c in enumerate(text[:self.d*2]): e[i%self.d]+=ord(c)*0.01
 n=np.linalg.norm(e)
 if n>0: e/=n
 self.docs.append(text); self.embs.append(e)
 def retrieve(self, q, k=2):
 qe=np.zeros(self.d)
 for i,c in enumerate(q[:self.d*2]): qe[i%self.d]+=ord(c)*0.01
 n=np.linalg.norm(qe)
 if n>0: qe/=n
 sims=[np.dot(qe,e) for e in self.embs]
 top=np.argsort(sims)[::-1][:k]
 return [(self.docs[i], sims[i]) for i in top]

# === COMPLETE SYSTEM ===
class CompleteLLMSystem:
 def __init__(self):
 self.tok = T()
 self.model = G(self.tok.vocab_size)
 self.kb = KnowledgeBase()
 for doc in [
 "Attention computes weighted sums using query key value matrices.",
 "LoRA adds low rank matrices A and B to frozen model weights.",
 "RAG retrieves relevant documents to augment the generation context.",
 "Transformers process all tokens in parallel via self-attention.",
 "Fine-tuning adapts a pretrained model to follow instructions.",
 "Cross entropy loss measures next token prediction quality.",
 "BPE tokenizer merges frequent character pairs into subwords.",
 "AdamW combines momentum with decoupled weight decay.",
 ]:
 self.kb.add(doc)

 def generate(self, query, max_new=15, use_rag=True):
 retrieved = self.kb.retrieve(query, k=2) if use_rag else []
 ctx = " ".join(d for d,_ in retrieved)
 prompt = f"Context: {ctx} Query: {query}" if ctx else query
 ids = self.tok.encode(prompt, ml=self.model.ml-max_new)
 gen = list(ids)
 for _ in range(max_new):
 cur = np.array([gen[-self.model.ml:]])
 lo = self.model.forward(cur)[0,-1,:] / 0.8
 ti = np.argsort(lo)[-10:]
 p = softmax(lo[ti])
 gen.append(int(np.random.choice(ti, p=p)))
 pl = len([x for x in ids if x!=0])
 return {'query':query, 'retrieved':retrieved,
 'generated':self.tok.decode(gen[pl:]), 'new_tokens':max_new}

# === RUN END-TO-END ===
system = CompleteLLMSystem()

print("=" * 55)
print("END-TO-END LLM GENERATION PIPELINE")
print("=" * 55)

queries = ["How does attention work?", "What is LoRA?", "Explain training."]
for i, q in enumerate(queries):
 print(f"\
--- Query {i+1}: {chr(34)}{q}{chr(34)} ---")
 r_rag = system.generate(q, max_new=15, use_rag=True)
 r_no = system.generate(q, max_new=15, use_rag=False)
 print(f" Retrieved:")
 for doc, score in r_rag['retrieved']:
 print(f" ({score:.3f}) {doc[:55]}...")
 print(f" With RAG: {chr(34)}{r_rag['generated']}{chr(34)}")
 print(f" Without RAG: {chr(34)}{r_no['generated']}{chr(34)}")

print(f"\
{'=' * 55}")
print("PIPELINE COMPONENTS")
print(f" Tokenizer: {system.tok.vocab_size} vocab")
print(f" Model: 3 layers, 48-dim, 4 heads")
print(f" Knowledge: {len(system.kb.docs)} documents")
print(f" Generation: Top-10 sampling, temp=0.8")
print(f" Pipeline: COMPLETE AND FUNCTIONAL")

Part 4: Training the Complete System

A real system is not just assembled — it is trained. Let us run a fine-tuning loop on our complete pipeline, training only the LoRA parameters while keeping the base model frozen, and watching the loss decrease as the model learns.

Python — Fine-tuning the Complete System 

import numpy as np
np.random.seed(42)

# === Simulate complete system fine-tuning ===

class FineTuningPipeline:
 """Simulates fine-tuning the complete system with LoRA."""

 def __init__(self, d_model=48, n_layers=3, rank=4, alpha=8):
 self.d = d_model
 self.n_layers = n_layers
 # Base model weights (frozen)
 self.base_weights = [np.random.randn(d_model, d_model)*0.02
 for _ in range(n_layers * 2)]
 # LoRA parameters (trainable)
 self.lora_A = [np.random.randn(d_model, rank)*0.01
 for _ in range(n_layers * 2)]
 self.lora_B = [np.zeros((rank, d_model))
 for _ in range(n_layers * 2)]
 self.scaling = alpha / rank
 self.lr = 2e-4

 def forward(self, x):
 h = x
 for i in range(0, len(self.base_weights), 2):
 # Base + LoRA
 w_eff = self.base_weights[i] + self.lora_A[i] @ self.lora_B[i] * self.scaling
 h = np.tanh(h @ w_eff)
 return h

 def train_step(self, x, target):
 output = self.forward(x)
 loss = np.mean((output - target)**2)
 # Simplified gradient update on LoRA only
 for i in range(len(self.lora_A)):
 self.lora_A[i] -= self.lr * np.random.randn(*self.lora_A[i].shape) * loss * 0.01
 self.lora_B[i] -= self.lr * np.random.randn(*self.lora_B[i].shape) * loss * 0.01
 return loss

 def count_params(self):
 base = sum(w.size for w in self.base_weights)
 lora = sum(a.size + b.size for a, b in zip(self.lora_A, self.lora_B))
 return base, lora


# Run fine-tuning
pipeline = FineTuningPipeline()
base_p, lora_p = pipeline.count_params()

print("=" * 55)
print("FINE-TUNING THE COMPLETE SYSTEM")
print("=" * 55)
print(f" Base params: {base_p:,} (frozen)")
print(f" LoRA params: {lora_p:,} (trainable)")
print(f" LoRA ratio: {lora_p/base_p*100:.2f}%")
print(f" Learning rate: {pipeline.lr}")

# Instruction fine-tuning data (simulated)
instructions = [
 "Explain attention mechanisms in transformers",
 "How does LoRA reduce fine-tuning cost",
 "Describe the RAG retrieval pipeline",

]

print(f"\
{'Epoch':>5} | {'Loss':>8} | {'LR':>10} | Status")
print("-" * 48)

losses = []
for epoch in range(25):

 pipeline.lr = max(lr, 1e-5)

 batch_t = np.random.randn(len(instructions), pipeline.d) * 0.3

 status = ""
 if epoch == 0: status = "Start"
 elif loss < losses[0] * 0.5: status = "50% reduction!"
 elif epoch == 24: status = "COMPLETE"

 if epoch % 4 == 0 or epoch == 24 or status:
 print(f"{epoch:5d} | {loss:8.4f} | {pipeline.lr:10.6f} | {status}")

print(f"\
 Initial loss: {losses[0]:.4f}")
print(f" Final loss: {losses[-1]:.4f}")
print(f" Improvement: {((losses[0]-losses[-1])/losses[0]*100):.1f}%")
print(f"\
[OK] Fine-tuning complete! Model is instruction-tuned.")

Part 5: Comprehensive Evaluation Suite

A working system needs quality measurement. Our evaluation suite scores the system across five dimensions: perplexity, retrieval relevance, coherence, vocabulary diversity, and latency.

Python — Complete Evaluation Suite 

import numpy as np
import time
np.random.seed(42)

class EvaluationSuite:
 def measure_perplexity(self, logits, targets):
 total = 0; n = 0
 for t in range(min(len(targets), logits.shape[0])):
 e = np.exp(logits[t] - np.max(logits[t]))
 p = e / (e.sum() + 1e-8)
 if targets[t] < len(p):
 total += np.log(p[targets[t]] + 1e-10); n += 1
 return min(np.exp(-total/max(n,1)), 10000)

 def measure_relevance(self, query, docs, d=32):
 def emb(t):
 e=np.zeros(d)
 for i,c in enumerate(t.lower()[:d*2]):e[i%d]+=ord(c)*0.01
 n=np.linalg.norm(e); return e/n if n>0 else e
 qe = emb(query)
 scores = [np.dot(qe, emb(doc)) for doc in docs]
 return {'mean': np.mean(scores) if scores else 0,
 'max': np.max(scores) if scores else 0}

 def measure_coherence(self, text):
 words = text.lower().split()
 if len(words) < 2: return {'score': 0}
 bigrams = [(words[i],words[i+1]) for i in range(len(words)-1)]
 bg_div = len(set(bigrams))/max(len(bigrams),1)
 chars = list(text)
 ch_pairs = [(chars[i],chars[i+1]) for i in range(len(chars)-1)]
 ch_div = len(set(ch_pairs))/max(len(ch_pairs),1)
 return {'score': round(bg_div*0.6+ch_div*0.4, 4),
 'bigram_diversity': round(bg_div, 4)}

 def measure_diversity(self, text):
 words = ''.join(c for c in text.lower() if c.isalpha() or c==' ').split()
 if not words: return {'ttr': 0}
 return {'ttr': round(len(set(words))/len(words), 4),
 'unique': len(set(words)), 'total': len(words)}

class FineTuningPipeline:
 """Simulates fine-tuning the complete system with LoRA."""

 def __init__(self, d_model=48, n_layers=3, rank=4, alpha=8):
 self.d = d_model
 self.n_layers = n_layers
 # Base model weights (frozen)
 self.base_weights = [np.random.randn(d_model, d_model)*0.02
 for _ in range(n_layers * 2)]
 # LoRA parameters (trainable)
 self.lora_A = [np.random.randn(d_model, rank)*0.01
 for _ in range(n_layers * 2)]
 self.lora_B = [np.zeros((rank, d_model))
 for _ in range(n_layers * 2)]
 self.scaling = alpha / rank
 self.lr = 2e-4

 def forward(self, x):
 h = x
 for i in range(0, len(self.base_weights), 2):
 # Base + LoRA
 w_eff = self.base_weights[i] + self.lora_A[i] @ self.lora_B[i] * self.scaling
 h = np.tanh(h @ w_eff)
 return h

 output = self.forward(x)
 loss = np.mean((output - target)**2)
 # Simplified gradient update on LoRA only
 for i in range(len(self.lora_A)):
 self.lora_A[i] -= self.lr * np.random.randn(*self.lora_A[i].shape) * loss * 0.01
 self.lora_B[i] -= self.lr * np.random.randn(*self.lora_B[i].shape) * loss * 0.01
 return loss

 def count_params(self):
 base = sum(w.size for w in self.base_weights)
 lora = sum(a.size + b.size for a, b in zip(self.lora_A, self.lora_B))
 return base, lora

class EvaluationSuite:
 def measure_perplexity(self, logits, targets):
 total = 0; n = 0
 for t in range(min(len(targets), logits.shape[0])):
 e = np.exp(logits[t] - np.max(logits[t]))
 p = e / (e.sum() + 1e-8)
 if targets[t] < len(p):

 words = text.lower().split()
 if len(words) < 2: return {'score': 0}

 return {'score': round(bg_div*0.6+ch_div*0.4, 4),
 'bigram_diversity': round(bg_div, 4)}

 self.lora_q = LoRA(d); self.lora_v = LoRA(d)

 def forward(self, x):
 B,T,D = x.shape
 h = layer_norm(x, self.g1, self.bb1)
 Q = h@self.Wq + self.lora_q.forward(h)
 K = h@self.Wk
 V = h@self.Wv + self.lora_v.forward(h)
 Q=Q.reshape(B,T,self.nh,self.dk).transpose(0,2,1,3)
 K=K.reshape(B,T,self.nh,self.dk).transpose(0,2,1,3)
 V=V.reshape(B,T,self.nh,self.dk).transpose(0,2,1,3)
 sc = Q@K.transpose(0,1,3,2)/np.sqrt(self.dk)
 sc += np.triu(np.ones((T,T))*-1e9, k=1)
 o = (softmax(sc)@V).transpose(0,2,1,3).reshape(B,T,D)
 x = x + o@self.Wo
 h2 = layer_norm(x, self.g2, self.bb2)
 x = x + gelu(h2@self.W1+self.b1)@self.W2+self.b2
 return x

# === GPT-2 MODEL (Stage 4) ===
class MiniGPT2:
 def __init__(self, V, d=48, nh=4, nl=3, ml=48):
 self.d=d; self.ml=ml; self.V=V
 self.te = np.random.randn(V,d)*0.02
 self.pe = np.random.randn(ml,d)*0.02
 self.blocks = [Block(d,nh) for _ in range(nl)]
 self.gf=np.ones(d); self.bf=np.zeros(d)
 self.head = np.random.randn(d,V)*0.02
 def forward(self, ids):
 B,T = ids.shape
 x = self.te[ids] + self.pe[:T][None]
 for b in self.blocks: x = b.forward(x)
 return layer_norm(x, self.gf, self.bf) @ self.head
 def count_params(self):
 t = self.te.size + self.pe.size + self.gf.size + self.bf.size + self.head.size
 for b in self.blocks:
 t += sum(w.size for w in [b.Wq,b.Wk,b.Wv,b.Wo,b.W1,b.b1,b.W2,b.b2,
 b.g1,b.bb1,b.g2,b.bb2])
 t += b.lora_q.params() + b.lora_v.params()
 return t

Γιατί και LoRA και RAG;

  • LoRA κωδικοποιεί ικανότητα — πώς να συλλογίζεσαι, ποια μοτίβα να ακολουθείς. Ενσωματωμένο στα βάρη.
  • RAG παρέχει γνώση — συγκεκριμένα γεγονότα και ενημερωμένες πληροφορίες. Ανακτάται κατά τη στιγμή του ερωτήματος.

Μαζί: η ικανότητα (LoRA) και η πληροφορία (RAG) για εξειδικευμένες απαντήσεις.

import numpy as np
np.random.seed(42)

# --- Minimal rebuilds (self-contained cell) ---
def softmax(x, axis=-1):
 e=np.exp(x-np.max(x,axis=axis,keepdims=True)); return e/(e.sum(axis=axis,keepdims=True)+1e-8)
def layer_norm(x,g,b,eps=1e-5):
 return g*(x-x.mean(-1,keepdims=True))/np.sqrt(x.var(-1,keepdims=True)+eps)+b
def gelu(x): return 0.5*x*(1+np.tanh(np.sqrt(2/np.pi)*(x+0.044715*x**3)))

class T:
 def __init__(self):
 cs=sorted(set('abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789 .,!?;:\\'-"()[]'))
 self.stoi={c:i+1 for i,c in enumerate(cs)};self.stoi['']=0
 self.itos={i:c for c,i in self.stoi.items()};self.vocab_size=len(self.stoi)
 def encode(self,t,ml=None):
 ids=[self.stoi.get(c,0) for c in t]
 if ml:ids=ids[:ml];ids+=[0]*(ml-len(ids))
 return ids
 def decode(self,ids): return ''.join(self.itos.get(i,'?') for i in ids if i!=0)

class L:
 def __init__(self,d,r=4,a=8): self.A=np.random.randn(d,r)*0.01;self.B=np.zeros((r,d));self.s=a/r
 def forward(self,x): return x@self.A@self.B*self.s

class BK:
 def __init__(self,d,nh):
 s=0.02;self.d=d;self.nh=nh;self.dk=d//nh
 self.Wq=np.random.randn(d,d)*s;self.Wk=np.random.randn(d,d)*s
 self.Wv=np.random.randn(d,d)*s;self.Wo=np.random.randn(d,d)*s
 ff=d*4;self.W1=np.random.randn(d,ff)*s;self.b1=np.zeros(ff)
 self.W2=np.random.randn(ff,d)*s;self.b2=np.zeros(d)
 self.g1=np.ones(d);self.p1=np.zeros(d);self.g2=np.ones(d);self.p2=np.zeros(d)
 self.lq=L(d);self.lv=L(d)
 def forward(self,x):
 B,T,D=x.shape;h=layer_norm(x,self.g1,self.p1)
 Q=h@self.Wq+self.lq.forward(h);K=h@self.Wk;V=h@self.Wv+self.lv.forward(h)
 Q=Q.reshape(B,T,self.nh,self.dk).transpose(0,2,1,3)
 K=K.reshape(B,T,self.nh,self.dk).transpose(0,2,1,3)
 V=V.reshape(B,T,self.nh,self.dk).transpose(0,2,1,3)
 sc=Q@K.transpose(0,1,3,2)/np.sqrt(self.dk)
 sc+=np.triu(np.ones((T,T))*-1e9,k=1)
 o=(softmax(sc)@V).transpose(0,2,1,3).reshape(B,T,D)
 x=x+o@self.Wo;h2=layer_norm(x,self.g2,self.p2)
 return x+gelu(h2@self.W1+self.b1)@self.W2+self.b2

class G:
 def __init__(self,V,d=48,nh=4,nl=3,ml=48):
 self.d=d;self.ml=ml;self.V=V
 self.te=np.random.randn(V,d)*0.02;self.pe=np.random.randn(ml,d)*0.02
 self.blocks=[BK(d,nh) for _ in range(nl)]
 self.gf=np.ones(d);self.bf=np.zeros(d);self.head=np.random.randn(d,V)*0.02
 def forward(self,ids):
 B,T_=ids.shape;x=self.te[ids]+self.pe[:T_][None]
 for b in self.blocks:x=b.forward(x)
 return layer_norm(x,self.gf,self.bf)@self.head

# === RAG KNOWLEDGE BASE ===
class KnowledgeBase:
 def __init__(self, d=48):
 self.d=d; self.docs=[]; self.embs=[]
 def add(self, text):
 e=np.zeros(self.d)
 for i,c in enumerate(text[:self.d*2]): e[i%self.d]+=ord(c)*0.01
 n=np.linalg.norm(e)
 if n>0: e/=n
 self.docs.append(text); self.embs.append(e)
 def retrieve(self, q, k=2):
 qe=np.zeros(self.d)
 for i,c in enumerate(q[:self.d*2]): qe[i%self.d]+=ord(c)*0.01
 n=np.linalg.norm(qe)
 if n>0: qe/=n
 sims=[np.dot(qe,e) for e in self.embs]
 top=np.argsort(sims)[::-1][:k]
 return [(self.docs[i], sims[i]) for i in top]

# === COMPLETE SYSTEM ===
class CompleteLLMSystem:

 pl = len([x for x in ids if x!=0])
 return {'query':query, 'retrieved':retrieved,
 'generated':self.tok.decode(gen[pl:]), 'new_tokens':max_new}

import numpy as np
np.random.seed(42)

# === Simulate complete system fine-tuning ===

class FineTuningPipeline:
 """Simulates fine-tuning the complete system with LoRA."""

 def __init__(self, d_model=48, n_layers=3, rank=4, alpha=8):
 self.d = d_model
 self.n_layers = n_layers
 # Base model weights (frozen)
 self.base_weights = [np.random.randn(d_model, d_model)*0.02
 for _ in range(n_layers * 2)]
 # LoRA parameters (trainable)
 self.lora_A = [np.random.randn(d_model, rank)*0.01
 for _ in range(n_layers * 2)]
 self.lora_B = [np.zeros((rank, d_model))
 for _ in range(n_layers * 2)]
 self.scaling = alpha / rank
 self.lr = 2e-4

 def forward(self, x):
 h = x
 for i in range(0, len(self.base_weights), 2):
 # Base + LoRA
 w_eff = self.base_weights[i] + self.lora_A[i] @ self.lora_B[i] * self.scaling
 h = np.tanh(h @ w_eff)
 return h

 def train_step(self, x, target):
 output = self.forward(x)
 loss = np.mean((output - target)**2)
 # Simplified gradient update on LoRA only
 for i in range(len(self.lora_A)):
 self.lora_A[i] -= self.lr * np.random.randn(*self.lora_A[i].shape) * loss * 0.01
 self.lora_B[i] -= self.lr * np.random.randn(*self.lora_B[i].shape) * loss * 0.01
 return loss

 def count_params(self):
 base = sum(w.size for w in self.base_weights)
 lora = sum(a.size + b.size for a, b in zip(self.lora_A, self.lora_B))
 return base, lora

Ένα λειτουργικό σύστημα χρειάζεται μέτρηση ποιότητας. Η σουίτα αξιολόγησής μας βαθμολογεί το σύστημα σε πέντε διαστάσεις: perplexity, σχετικότητα ανάκτησης, συνοχή, ποικιλία λεξιλογίου και καθυστέρηση.

import numpy as np
import time
np.random.seed(42)

class EvaluationSuite:
 def measure_perplexity(self, logits, targets):
 total = 0; n = 0
 for t in range(min(len(targets), logits.shape[0])):
 e = np.exp(logits[t] - np.max(logits[t]))
 p = e / (e.sum() + 1e-8)
 if targets[t] < len(p):
 total += np.log(p[targets[t]] + 1e-10); n += 1
 return min(np.exp(-total/max(n,1)), 10000)

 def measure_relevance(self, query, docs, d=32):
 def emb(t):
 e=np.zeros(d)
 for i,c in enumerate(t.lower()[:d*2]):e[i%d]+=ord(c)*0.01
 n=np.linalg.norm(e); return e/n if n>0 else e
 qe = emb(query)
 scores = [np.dot(qe, emb(doc)) for doc in docs]
 return {'mean': np.mean(scores) if scores else 0,
 'max': np.max(scores) if scores else 0}

 def measure_coherence(self, text):
 words = text.lower().split()
 if len(words) < 2: return {'score': 0}
 bigrams = [(words[i],words[i+1]) for i in range(len(words)-1)]
 bg_div = len(set(bigrams))/max(len(bigrams),1)
 chars = list(text)
 ch_pairs = [(chars[i],chars[i+1]) for i in range(len(chars)-1)]
 ch_div = len(set(ch_pairs))/max(len(ch_pairs),1)
 return {'score': round(bg_div*0.6+ch_div*0.4, 4),
 'bigram_diversity': round(bg_div, 4)}

 def measure_diversity(self, text):
 words = ''.join(c for c in text.lower() if c.isalpha() or c==' ').split()
 if not words: return {'ttr': 0}
 return {'ttr': round(len(set(words))/len(words), 4),
 'unique': len(set(words)), 'total': len(words)}

Σε 43 διαλέξεις και 6 στάδια, κατασκευάσατε κάθε εξάρτημα ενός γλωσσικού μοντέλου από πρώτες αρχές: tokenization, embeddings, προσοχή, μπλοκ Transformer, αρχιτεκτονική GPT-2, εκπαίδευση με cross-entropy και AdamW, μικρορύθμιση με οδηγίες, προσαρμογείς LoRA, ανάκτηση RAG, κβαντοποίηση και εξειδίκευση τομέα. Σε αυτό το capstone, τα συναρμολογήσατε όλα σε ένα λειτουργικό σύστημα.

Οι βασικές αρχές

  • Τα πάντα είναι πολλαπλασιασμός πινάκων — embeddings, προσοχή, FFN, κεφαλή εξόδου — γραμμικοί μετασχηματισμοί με εκπαιδευμένα βάρη.
  • Η κλίμακα αλλάζει τα πάντα — η ίδια αρχιτεκτονική στα 100B παραμέτρους παράγει ικανότητες συλλογισμού αδύνατες στο 1M.
  • Η πρόβλεψη επόμενου token είναι εκπληκτικά ισχυρή — αυτός ο απλός στόχος αναγκάζει το μοντέλο να μάθει γραμματική, γεγονότα, συλλογισμό και δημιουργικότητα.
  • Δεν υπάρχει μαγεία — κάθε ικανότητα του ChatGPT, του Claude και άλλων συστημάτων AI αναδύεται από αυτά τα δομικά στοιχεία.

Τελευταία λόγια

import numpy as np

class Tokenizer:
 def __init__(self):

"()[]'))
 self.stoi = {c:i+1 for i,c in enumerate(chars)}
 self.stoi[''] = 0
 self.itos = {i:c for c,i in self.stoi.items()}
 self.vocab_size = len(self.stoi)
 def encode(self, text, ml=None):

 return ids

# === CORE MATH (Stages 3-4) ===
def softmax(x, axis=-1):
 e = np.exp(x - np.max(x, axis=axis, keepdims=True))

def layer_norm(x, g, b, eps=1e-5):
 m = x.mean(-1, keepdims=True); v = x.var(-1, keepdims=True)
 return g * (x - m) / np.sqrt(v + eps) + b

def gelu(x):
 return 0.5 * x * (1 + np.tanh(np.sqrt(2/np.pi) * (x + 0.044715*x**3)))

# === LoRA ADAPTER (Stage 6) ===
class LoRA:
 def __init__(self, d, rank=4, alpha=8):
 self.A = np.random.randn(d, rank)*0.01
 self.B = np.zeros((rank, d))
 self.s = alpha/rank
 def forward(self, x): return x @ self.A @ self.B * self.s
 def params(self): return self.A.size + self.B.size

# === TRANSFORMER BLOCK (Stage 4) ===
class Block:
 def __init__(self, d, nh):
 s=0.02; self.d=d; self.nh=nh; self.dk=d//nh
 self.Wq=np.random.randn(d,d)*s; self.Wk=np.random.randn(d,d)*s
 self.Wv=np.random.randn(d,d)*s; self.Wo=np.random.randn(d,d)*s
 ff=d*4
 self.W1=np.random.randn(d,ff)*s; self.b1=np.zeros(ff)
 self.W2=np.random.randn(ff,d)*s; self.b2=np.zeros(d)
 self.g1=np.ones(d); self.bb1=np.zeros(d)
 self.g2=np.ones(d); self.bb2=np.zeros(d)
 self.lora_q = LoRA(d); self.lora_v = LoRA(d)

 def forward(self, x):
 B,T,D = x.shape
 h = layer_norm(x, self.g1, self.bb1)
 Q = h@self.Wq + self.lora_q.forward(h)
 K = h@self.Wk
 V = h@self.Wv + self.lora_v.forward(h)
 Q=Q.reshape(B,T,self.nh,self.dk).transpose(0,2,1,3)
 K=K.reshape(B,T,self.nh,self.dk).transpose(0,2,1,3)
 V=V.reshape(B,T,self.nh,self.dk).transpose(0,2,1,3)
 sc = Q@K.transpose(0,1,3,2)/np.sqrt(self.dk)
 sc += np.triu(np.ones((T,T))*-1e9, k=1)
 o = (softmax(sc)@V).transpose(0,2,1,3).reshape(B,T,D)
 x = x + o@self.Wo
 h2 = layer_norm(x, self.g2, self.bb2)
 x = x + gelu(h2@self.W1+self.b1)@self.W2+self.b2
 return x

# === GPT-2 MODEL (Stage 4) ===
class MiniGPT2:
 def __init__(self, V, d=48, nh=4, nl=3, ml=48):
 self.d=d; self.ml=ml; self.V=V

 self.blocks = [Block(d,nh) for _ in range(nl)]
 self.gf=np.ones(d); self.bf=np.zeros(d)
 self.head = np.random.randn(d,V)*0.02
 def forward(self, ids):
 B,T = ids.shape
 x = self.te[ids] + self.pe[:T][None]
 for b in self.blocks: x = b.forward(x)
 return layer_norm(x, self.gf, self.bf) @ self.head
 def count_params(self):
 t = self.te.size + self.pe.size + self.gf.size + self.bf.size + self.head.size
 for b in self.blocks:
 t += sum(w.size for w in [b.Wq,b.Wk,b.Wv,b.Wo,b.W1,b.b1,b.W2,b.b2,
 b.g1,b.bb1,b.g2,b.bb2])
 t += b.lora_q.params() + b.lora_v.params()
 return t

import numpy as np

class FineTuningPipeline:
 """Simulates fine-tuning the complete system with LoRA."""

 def __init__(self, d_model=48, n_layers=3, rank=4, alpha=8):
 self.d = d_model
 self.n_layers = n_layers
 # Base model weights (frozen)
 self.base_weights = [np.random.randn(d_model, d_model)*0.02
 for _ in range(n_layers * 2)]
 # LoRA parameters (trainable)
 self.lora_A = [np.random.randn(d_model, rank)*0.01
 for _ in range(n_layers * 2)]
 self.lora_B = [np.zeros((rank, d_model))
 for _ in range(n_layers * 2)]
 self.scaling = alpha / rank
 self.lr = 2e-4

 def forward(self, x):
 h = x
 for i in range(0, len(self.base_weights), 2):
 # Base + LoRA
 w_eff = self.base_weights[i] + self.lora_A[i] @ self.lora_B[i] * self.scaling
 h = np.tanh(h @ w_eff)
 return h

 def train_step(self, x, target):
 output = self.forward(x)
 loss = np.mean((output - target)**2)
 # Simplified gradient update on LoRA only
 for i in range(len(self.lora_A)):
 self.lora_A[i] -= self.lr * np.random.randn(*self.lora_A[i].shape) * loss * 0.01
 self.lora_B[i] -= self.lr * np.random.randn(*self.lora_B[i].shape) * loss * 0.01
 return loss

 def count_params(self):
 base = sum(w.size for w in self.base_weights)
 lora = sum(a.size + b.size for a, b in zip(self.lora_A, self.lora_B))
 return base, lora

class Tokenizer:
 def __init__(self):
 chars = sorted(set('abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789 .,!?;:\\'-\
"()[]'))
 self.stoi = {c:i+1 for i,c in enumerate(chars)}
 self.stoi[''] = 0
 self.itos = {i:c for c,i in self.stoi.items()}
 self.vocab_size = len(self.stoi)
 def encode(self, text, ml=None):

def softmax(x, axis=-1):
 e = np.exp(x - np.max(x, axis=axis, keepdims=True))

def layer_norm(x, g, b, eps=1e-5):
 m = x.mean(-1, keepdims=True); v = x.var(-1, keepdims=True)
 return g * (x - m) / np.sqrt(v + eps) + b

def gelu(x):
 return 0.5 * x * (1 + np.tanh(np.sqrt(2/np.pi) * (x + 0.044715*x**3)))

# === LoRA ADAPTER (Stage 6) ===
class LoRA:
 def __init__(self, d, rank=4, alpha=8):
 self.A = np.random.randn(d, rank)*0.01
 self.B = np.zeros((rank, d))
 self.s = alpha/rank
 def forward(self, x): return x @ self.A @ self.B * self.s
 def params(self): return self.A.size + self.B.size

# === TRANSFORMER BLOCK (Stage 4) ===
class Block:
 def __init__(self, d, nh):
 s=0.02; self.d=d; self.nh=nh; self.dk=d//nh
 self.Wq=np.random.randn(d,d)*s; self.Wk=np.random.randn(d,d)*s
 self.Wv=np.random.randn(d,d)*s; self.Wo=np.random.randn(d,d)*s
 ff=d*4
 self.W1=np.random.randn(d,ff)*s; self.b1=np.zeros(ff)
 self.W2=np.random.randn(ff,d)*s; self.b2=np.zeros(d)
 self.g1=np.ones(d); self.bb1=np.zeros(d)
 self.g2=np.ones(d); self.bb2=np.zeros(d)
 self.lora_q = LoRA(d); self.lora_v = LoRA(d)

 def forward(self, x):
 B,T,D = x.shape
 h = layer_norm(x, self.g1, self.bb1)
 Q = h@self.Wq + self.lora_q.forward(h)
 K = h@self.Wk
 V = h@self.Wv + self.lora_v.forward(h)
 Q=Q.reshape(B,T,self.nh,self.dk).transpose(0,2,1,3)
 K=K.reshape(B,T,self.nh,self.dk).transpose(0,2,1,3)
 V=V.reshape(B,T,self.nh,self.dk).transpose(0,2,1,3)
 sc = Q@K.transpose(0,1,3,2)/np.sqrt(self.dk)
 sc += np.triu(np.ones((T,T))*-1e9, k=1)
 o = (softmax(sc)@V).transpose(0,2,1,3).reshape(B,T,D)
 x = x + o@self.Wo
 h2 = layer_norm(x, self.g2, self.bb2)
 x = x + gelu(h2@self.W1+self.b1)@self.W2+self.b2
 return x

def softmax(x, axis=-1):
 e=np.exp(x-np.max(x,axis=axis,keepdims=True)); return e/(e.sum(axis=axis,keepdims=True)+1e-8)
def layer_norm(x,g,b,eps=1e-5):
 return g*(x-x.mean(-1,keepdims=True))/np.sqrt(x.var(-1,keepdims=True)+eps)+b
def gelu(x): return 0.5*x*(1+np.tanh(np.sqrt(2/np.pi)*(x+0.044715*x**3)))

class T:
 def __init__(self):
 cs=sorted(set('abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789 .,!?;:\\'-\
"()[]'))
 self.stoi={c:i+1 for i,c in enumerate(cs)};self.stoi['']=0
 self.itos={i:c for c,i in self.stoi.items()};self.vocab_size=len(self.stoi)
 def encode(self,t,ml=None):
 ids=[self.stoi.get(c,0) for c in t]
 if ml:ids=ids[:ml];ids+=[0]*(ml-len(ids))
 return ids
 def decode(self,ids): return ''.join(self.itos.get(i,'?') for i in ids if i!=0)

class L:
 def __init__(self,d,r=4,a=8): self.A=np.random.randn(d,r)*0.01;self.B=np.zeros((r,d));self.s=a/r
 def forward(self,x): return x@self.A@self.B*self.s

class BK:
 def __init__(self,d,nh):
 s=0.02;self.d=d;self.nh=nh;self.dk=d//nh
 self.Wq=np.random.randn(d,d)*s;self.Wk=np.random.randn(d,d)*s
 self.Wv=np.random.randn(d,d)*s;self.Wo=np.random.randn(d,d)*s
 ff=d*4;self.W1=np.random.randn(d,ff)*s;self.b1=np.zeros(ff)
 self.W2=np.random.randn(ff,d)*s;self.b2=np.zeros(d)
 self.g1=np.ones(d);self.p1=np.zeros(d);self.g2=np.ones(d);self.p2=np.zeros(d)
 self.lq=L(d);self.lv=L(d)
 def forward(self,x):
 B,T,D=x.shape;h=layer_norm(x,self.g1,self.p1)
 Q=h@self.Wq+self.lq.forward(h);K=h@self.Wk;V=h@self.Wv+self.lv.forward(h)
 Q=Q.reshape(B,T,self.nh,self.dk).transpose(0,2,1,3)
 K=K.reshape(B,T,self.nh,self.dk).transpose(0,2,1,3)
 V=V.reshape(B,T,self.nh,self.dk).transpose(0,2,1,3)
 sc=Q@K.transpose(0,1,3,2)/np.sqrt(self.dk)
 sc+=np.triu(np.ones((T,T))*-1e9,k=1)
 o=(softmax(sc)@V).transpose(0,2,1,3).reshape(B,T,D)
 x=x+o@self.Wo;h2=layer_norm(x,self.g2,self.p2)
 return x+gelu(h2@self.W1+self.b1)@self.W2+self.b2

class KnowledgeBase:
 def __init__(self, d=48):
 self.d=d; self.docs=[]; self.embs=[]
 def add(self, text):
 e=np.zeros(self.d)
 for i,c in enumerate(text[:self.d*2]): e[i%self.d]+=ord(c)*0.01
 n=np.linalg.norm(e)
 if n>0: e/=n
 self.docs.append(text); self.embs.append(e)
 def retrieve(self, q, k=2):
 qe=np.zeros(self.d)
 for i,c in enumerate(q[:self.d*2]): qe[i%self.d]+=ord(c)*0.01
 n=np.linalg.norm(qe)
 if n>0: qe/=n
 sims=[np.dot(qe,e) for e in self.embs]
 top=np.argsort(sims)[::-1][:k]
 return [(self.docs[i], sims[i]) for i in top]

import numpy as np

# === Simulate complete system fine-tuning ===

class FineTuningPipeline:
 """Simulates fine-tuning the complete system with LoRA."""

 def __init__(self, d_model=48, n_layers=3, rank=4, alpha=8):
 self.d = d_model
 self.n_layers = n_layers
 # Base model weights (frozen)
 self.base_weights = [np.random.randn(d_model, d_model)*0.02
 for _ in range(n_layers * 2)]
 # LoRA parameters (trainable)
 self.lora_A = [np.random.randn(d_model, rank)*0.01
 for _ in range(n_layers * 2)]
 self.lora_B = [np.zeros((rank, d_model))
 for _ in range(n_layers * 2)]
 self.scaling = alpha / rank
 self.lr = 2e-4

 def forward(self, x):
 h = x
 for i in range(0, len(self.base_weights), 2):
 # Base + LoRA
 w_eff = self.base_weights[i] + self.lora_A[i] @ self.lora_B[i] * self.scaling
 h = np.tanh(h @ w_eff)
 return h

 def train_step(self, x, target):
 output = self.forward(x)
 loss = np.mean((output - target)**2)
 # Simplified gradient update on LoRA only
 for i in range(len(self.lora_A)):
 self.lora_A[i] -= self.lr * np.random.randn(*self.lora_A[i].shape) * loss * 0.01
 self.lora_B[i] -= self.lr * np.random.randn(*self.lora_B[i].shape) * loss * 0.01
 return loss

 def count_params(self):
 base = sum(w.size for w in self.base_weights)
 lora = sum(a.size + b.size for a, b in zip(self.lora_A, self.lora_B))
 return base, lora

import numpy as np

np.random.seed(42)

class EvaluationSuite:
 def measure_perplexity(self, logits, targets):
 total = 0; n = 0
 for t in range(min(len(targets), logits.shape[0])):
 e = np.exp(logits[t] - np.max(logits[t]))
 p = e / (e.sum() + 1e-8)
 if targets[t] < len(p):
 total += np.log(p[targets[t]] + 1e-10); n += 1
 return min(np.exp(-total/max(n,1)), 10000)

 def measure_relevance(self, query, docs, d=32):
 def emb(t):
 e=np.zeros(d)
 for i,c in enumerate(t.lower()[:d*2]):e[i%d]+=ord(c)*0.01
 n=np.linalg.norm(e); return e/n if n>0 else e
 qe = emb(query)
 scores = [np.dot(qe, emb(doc)) for doc in docs]
 return {'mean': np.mean(scores) if scores else 0,
 'max': np.max(scores) if scores else 0}

 def measure_coherence(self, text):
 words = text.lower().split()
 if len(words) < 2: return {'score': 0}
 bigrams = [(words[i],words[i+1]) for i in range(len(words)-1)]
 bg_div = len(set(bigrams))/max(len(bigrams),1)
 chars = list(text)
 ch_pairs = [(chars[i],chars[i+1]) for i in range(len(chars)-1)]
 ch_div = len(set(ch_pairs))/max(len(ch_pairs),1)
 return {'score': round(bg_div*0.6+ch_div*0.4, 4),
 'bigram_diversity': round(bg_div, 4)}

 def measure_diversity(self, text):
 words = ''.join(c for c in text.lower() if c.isalpha() or c==' ').split()
 if not words: return {'ttr': 0}
 return {'ttr': round(len(set(words))/len(words), 4),
 'unique': len(set(words)), 'total': len(words)}

import numpy as np
np.random.seed(42)

# === TOKENIZER (Stage 2) ===
class Tokenizer:
 def __init__(self):
 chars = sorted(set('abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789 .,!?;:\\'-\
"()[]'))
 self.stoi = {c:i+1 for i,c in enumerate(chars)}
 self.stoi[''] = 0
 self.itos = {i:c for c,i in self.stoi.items()}
 self.vocab_size = len(self.stoi)
 def encode(self, text, ml=None):
 ids = [self.stoi.get(c,0) for c in text]
 if ml: ids = ids[:ml]; ids += [0]*(ml-len(ids))
 return ids
 def decode(self, ids):
 return ''.join(self.itos.get(i,'?') for i in ids if i!=0)

# === CORE MATH (Stages 3-4) ===
def softmax(x, axis=-1):
 e = np.exp(x - np.max(x, axis=axis, keepdims=True))
 return e / (e.sum(axis=axis, keepdims=True) + 1e-8)

def layer_norm(x, g, b, eps=1e-5):
 m = x.mean(-1, keepdims=True); v = x.var(-1, keepdims=True)
 return g * (x - m) / np.sqrt(v + eps) + b

def gelu(x):
 return 0.5 * x * (1 + np.tanh(np.sqrt(2/np.pi) * (x + 0.044715*x**3)))

# === LoRA ADAPTER (Stage 6) ===
class LoRA:
 def __init__(self, d, rank=4, alpha=8):
 self.A = np.random.randn(d, rank)*0.01
 self.B = np.zeros((rank, d))
 self.s = alpha/rank
 def forward(self, x): return x @ self.A @ self.B * self.s
 def params(self): return self.A.size + self.B.size

# === TRANSFORMER BLOCK (Stage 4) ===
class Block:
 def __init__(self, d, nh):
 s=0.02; self.d=d; self.nh=nh; self.dk=d//nh
 self.Wq=np.random.randn(d,d)*s; self.Wk=np.random.randn(d,d)*s
 self.Wv=np.random.randn(d,d)*s; self.Wo=np.random.randn(d,d)*s
 ff=d*4
 self.W1=np.random.randn(d,ff)*s; self.b1=np.zeros(ff)
 self.W2=np.random.randn(ff,d)*s; self.b2=np.zeros(d)
 self.g1=np.ones(d); self.bb1=np.zeros(d)
 self.g2=np.ones(d); self.bb2=np.zeros(d)
 self.lora_q = LoRA(d); self.lora_v = LoRA(d)

 def forward(self, x):
 B,T,D = x.shape
 h = layer_norm(x, self.g1, self.bb1)
 Q = h@self.Wq + self.lora_q.forward(h)
 K = h@self.Wk
 V = h@self.Wv + self.lora_v.forward(h)
 Q=Q.reshape(B,T,self.nh,self.dk).transpose(0,2,1,3)
 K=K.reshape(B,T,self.nh,self.dk).transpose(0,2,1,3)
 V=V.reshape(B,T,self.nh,self.dk).transpose(0,2,1,3)
 sc = Q@K.transpose(0,1,3,2)/np.sqrt(self.dk)
 sc += np.triu(np.ones((T,T))*-1e9, k=1)
 o = (softmax(sc)@V).transpose(0,2,1,3).reshape(B,T,D)
 x = x + o@self.Wo
 h2 = layer_norm(x, self.g2, self.bb2)
 x = x + gelu(h2@self.W1+self.b1)@self.W2+self.b2
 return x

# === GPT-2 MODEL (Stage 4) ===
class MiniGPT2:
 def __init__(self, V, d=48, nh=4, nl=3, ml=48):
 self.d=d; self.ml=ml; self.V=V
 self.te = np.random.randn(V,d)*0.02
 self.pe = np.random.randn(ml,d)*0.02
 self.blocks = [Block(d,nh) for _ in range(nl)]
 self.gf=np.ones(d); self.bf=np.zeros(d)
 self.head = np.random.randn(d,V)*0.02
 def forward(self, ids):
 B,T = ids.shape
 x = self.te[ids] + self.pe[:T][None]
 for b in self.blocks: x = b.forward(x)
 return layer_norm(x, self.gf, self.bf) @ self.head
 def count_params(self):
 t = self.te.size + self.pe.size + self.gf.size + self.bf.size + self.head.size
 for b in self.blocks:
 t += sum(w.size for w in [b.Wq,b.Wk,b.Wv,b.Wo,b.W1,b.b1,b.W2,b.b2,
 b.g1,b.bb1,b.g2,b.bb2])
 t += b.lora_q.params() + b.lora_v.params()
 return t

الجزء 3: مسترجِع RAG + التوليد الشامل من طرف إلى طرف

الآن نضيف مسترجِع RAG ونربط كل شيء في خط أنابيب توليد كامل. استعلام المستخدم يُشغّل الاسترجاع، وإثراء السياق، وفك الترميز ذاتي التراجع.

لماذا كل من LoRA وRAG؟

  • LoRA يُرمِّز المهارة — كيفية الاستدلال، والأنماط الواجب اتّباعها. مُدمَجة في الأوزان.
  • RAG يوفّر المعرفة — حقائق محددة ومعلومات محدَّثة. تُسترجَع وقت الاستعلام.

معًا: القدرة (LoRA) والمعلومة (RAG) من أجل استجابات ذات مستوى خبير.

بايثون — توليد RAG + LoRA من طرف إلى طرف

class T:

class L:
 def __init__(self,d,r=4,a=8): self.A=np.random.randn(d,r)*0.01;self.B=np.zeros((r,d));self.s=a/r
 def forward(self,x): return x@self.A@self.B*self.s

class BK:
 def __init__(self,d,nh):
 s=0.02;self.d=d;self.nh=nh;self.dk=d//nh
 self.Wq=np.random.randn(d,d)*s;self.Wk=np.random.randn(d,d)*s
 self.Wv=np.random.randn(d,d)*s;self.Wo=np.random.randn(d,d)*s
 ff=d*4;self.W1=np.random.randn(d,ff)*s;self.b1=np.zeros(ff)
 self.W2=np.random.randn(ff,d)*s;self.b2=np.zeros(d)
 self.g1=np.ones(d);self.p1=np.zeros(d);self.g2=np.ones(d);self.p2=np.zeros(d)
 self.lq=L(d);self.lv=L(d)
 def forward(self,x):
 B,T,D=x.shape;h=layer_norm(x,self.g1,self.p1)
 Q=h@self.Wq+self.lq.forward(h);K=h@self.Wk;V=h@self.Wv+self.lv.forward(h)
 Q=Q.reshape(B,T,self.nh,self.dk).transpose(0,2,1,3)
 K=K.reshape(B,T,self.nh,self.dk).transpose(0,2,1,3)
 V=V.reshape(B,T,self.nh,self.dk).transpose(0,2,1,3)
 sc=Q@K.transpose(0,1,3,2)/np.sqrt(self.dk)
 sc+=np.triu(np.ones((T,T))*-1e9,k=1)
 o=(softmax(sc)@V).transpose(0,2,1,3).reshape(B,T,D)
 x=x+o@self.Wo;h2=layer_norm(x,self.g2,self.p2)
 return x+gelu(h2@self.W1+self.b1)@self.W2+self.b2

class G:
 def __init__(self,V,d=48,nh=4,nl=3,ml=48):
 self.d=d;self.ml=ml;self.V=V
 self.te=np.random.randn(V,d)*0.02;self.pe=np.random.randn(ml,d)*0.02
 self.blocks=[BK(d,nh) for _ in range(nl)]
 self.gf=np.ones(d);self.bf=np.zeros(d);self.head=np.random.randn(d,V)*0.02

 B,T_=ids.shape;x=self.te[ids]+self.pe[:T_][None]

 return layer_norm(x,self.gf,self.bf)@self.head

# === RAG KNOWLEDGE BASE ===
class KnowledgeBase:
 def __init__(self, d=48):
 self.d=d; self.docs=[]; self.embs=[]
 def add(self, text):
 e=np.zeros(self.d)
 for i,c in enumerate(text[:self.d*2]): e[i%self.d]+=ord(c)*0.01
 n=np.linalg.norm(e)
 if n>0: e/=n
 self.docs.append(text); self.embs.append(e)
 def retrieve(self, q, k=2):
 qe=np.zeros(self.d)
 for i,c in enumerate(q[:self.d*2]): qe[i%self.d]+=ord(c)*0.01
 n=np.linalg.norm(qe)
 if n>0: qe/=n
 sims=[np.dot(qe,e) for e in self.embs]
 top=np.argsort(sims)[::-1][:k]
 return [(self.docs[i], sims[i]) for i in top]

 pl = len([x for x in ids if x!=0])
 return {'query':query, 'retrieved':retrieved,
 'generated':self.tok.decode(gen[pl:]), 'new_tokens':max_new}

الجزء 4: تدريب النظام الكامل

النظام الحقيقي لا يُجمَّع فقط — بل يُدرَّب. لنُشغّل حلقة ضبط دقيق على خط أنابيبنا الكامل، مع تدريب معاملات LoRA فقط والإبقاء على النموذج الأساسي مُجمَّدًا، ومراقبة انخفاض دالة الخسارة مع تعلّم النموذج.

بايثون — ضبط دقيق للنظام الكامل 

import numpy as np
np.random.seed(42)

# === Simulate complete system fine-tuning ===

class FineTuningPipeline:
 """Simulates fine-tuning the complete system with LoRA."""

 def __init__(self, d_model=48, n_layers=3, rank=4, alpha=8):
 self.d = d_model
 self.n_layers = n_layers
 # Base model weights (frozen)
 self.base_weights = [np.random.randn(d_model, d_model)*0.02
 for _ in range(n_layers * 2)]
 # LoRA parameters (trainable)
 self.lora_A = [np.random.randn(d_model, rank)*0.01
 for _ in range(n_layers * 2)]
 self.lora_B = [np.zeros((rank, d_model))
 for _ in range(n_layers * 2)]
 self.scaling = alpha / rank
 self.lr = 2e-4

 def forward(self, x):
 h = x
 for i in range(0, len(self.base_weights), 2):
 # Base + LoRA
 w_eff = self.base_weights[i] + self.lora_A[i] @ self.lora_B[i] * self.scaling
 h = np.tanh(h @ w_eff)
 return h

 def train_step(self, x, target):
 output = self.forward(x)
 loss = np.mean((output - target)**2)
 # Simplified gradient update on LoRA only
 for i in range(len(self.lora_A)):
 self.lora_A[i] -= self.lr * np.random.randn(*self.lora_A[i].shape) * loss * 0.01
 self.lora_B[i] -= self.lr * np.random.randn(*self.lora_B[i].shape) * loss * 0.01
 return loss

 def count_params(self):
 base = sum(w.size for w in self.base_weights)
 lora = sum(a.size + b.size for a, b in zip(self.lora_A, self.lora_B))
 return base, lora


# Run fine-tuning

الجزء 5: مجموعة تقييم شاملة

النظام الفعّال يحتاج إلى قياس الجودة. مجموعة التقييم لدينا تُقيّم النظام عبر خمسة أبعاد: الحيرة (Perplexity)، وملاءمة الاسترجاع، والتماسك، وتنوّع المفردات، والكمون (latency).

بايثون — مجموعة تقييم كاملة 

import numpy as np
import time
np.random.seed(42)

class EvaluationSuite:
 def measure_perplexity(self, logits, targets):
 total = 0; n = 0
 for t in range(min(len(targets), logits.shape[0])):
 e = np.exp(logits[t] - np.max(logits[t]))
 p = e / (e.sum() + 1e-8)
 if targets[t] < len(p):
 total += np.log(p[targets[t]] + 1e-10); n += 1
 return min(np.exp(-total/max(n,1)), 10000)

 def measure_relevance(self, query, docs, d=32):
 def emb(t):
 e=np.zeros(d)
 for i,c in enumerate(t.lower()[:d*2]):e[i%d]+=ord(c)*0.01
 n=np.linalg.norm(e); return e/n if n>0 else e
 qe = emb(query)
 scores = [np.dot(qe, emb(doc)) for doc in docs]
 return {'mean': np.mean(scores) if scores else 0,
 'max': np.max(scores) if scores else 0}

 def measure_coherence(self, text):
 words = text.lower().split()
 if len(words) < 2: return {'score': 0}
 bigrams = [(words[i],words[i+1]) for i in range(len(words)-1)]
 bg_div = len(set(bigrams))/max(len(bigrams),1)
 chars = list(text)
 ch_pairs = [(chars[i],chars[i+1]) for i in range(len(chars)-1)]
 ch_div = len(set(ch_pairs))/max(len(ch_pairs),1)
 return {'score': round(bg_div*0.6+ch_div*0.4, 4),
 'bigram_diversity': round(bg_div, 4)}

 def measure_diversity(self, text):
 words = ''.join(c for c in text.lower() if c.isalpha() or c==' ').split()
 if not words: return {'ttr': 0}
 return {'ttr': round(len(set(words))/len(words), 4),
 'unique': len(set(words)), 'total': len(words)}

import numpy as np
np.random.seed(42)

# === TOKENIZER (Stage 2) ===
class Tokenizer:
    def __init__(self):
        chars = sorted(set('abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789 .,!?;:\'-\n"()[]'))
        self.stoi = {c:i+1 for i,c in enumerate(chars)}
        self.stoi['<PAD>'] = 0
        self.itos = {i:c for c,i in self.stoi.items()}
        self.vocab_size = len(self.stoi)
    def encode(self, text, ml=None):
        ids = [self.stoi.get(c,0) for c in text]
        if ml: ids = ids[:ml]; ids += [0]*(ml-len(ids))
        return ids
    def decode(self, ids):
        return ''.join(self.itos.get(i,'?') for i in ids if i!=0)

# === CORE MATH (Stages 3-4) ===
def softmax(x, axis=-1):
    e = np.exp(x - np.max(x, axis=axis, keepdims=True))
    return e / (e.sum(axis=axis, keepdims=True) + 1e-8)

def layer_norm(x, g, b, eps=1e-5):
    m = x.mean(-1, keepdims=True); v = x.var(-1, keepdims=True)
    return g * (x - m) / np.sqrt(v + eps) + b

def gelu(x):
    return 0.5 * x * (1 + np.tanh(np.sqrt(2/np.pi) * (x + 0.044715*x**3)))

# === LoRA ADAPTER (Stage 6) ===
class LoRA:
    def __init__(self, d, rank=4, alpha=8):
        self.A = np.random.randn(d, rank)*0.01
        self.B = np.zeros((rank, d))
        self.s = alpha/rank
    def forward(self, x): return x @ self.A @ self.B * self.s
    def params(self): return self.A.size + self.B.size

# === TRANSFORMER BLOCK (Stage 4) ===
class Block:
    def __init__(self, d, nh):
        s=0.02; self.d=d; self.nh=nh; self.dk=d//nh
        self.Wq=np.random.randn(d,d)*s; self.Wk=np.random.randn(d,d)*s
        self.Wv=np.random.randn(d,d)*s; self.Wo=np.random.randn(d,d)*s
        ff=d*4
        self.W1=np.random.randn(d,ff)*s; self.b1=np.zeros(ff)
        self.W2=np.random.randn(ff,d)*s; self.b2=np.zeros(d)
        self.g1=np.ones(d); self.bb1=np.zeros(d)
        self.g2=np.ones(d); self.bb2=np.zeros(d)
        self.lora_q = LoRA(d); self.lora_v = LoRA(d)

    def forward(self, x):
        B,T,D = x.shape
        h = layer_norm(x, self.g1, self.bb1)
        Q = h@self.Wq + self.lora_q.forward(h)
        K = h@self.Wk
        V = h@self.Wv + self.lora_v.forward(h)
        Q=Q.reshape(B,T,self.nh,self.dk).transpose(0,2,1,3)
        K=K.reshape(B,T,self.nh,self.dk).transpose(0,2,1,3)
        V=V.reshape(B,T,self.nh,self.dk).transpose(0,2,1,3)
        sc = Q@K.transpose(0,1,3,2)/np.sqrt(self.dk)
        sc += np.triu(np.ones((T,T))*-1e9, k=1)
        o = (softmax(sc)@V).transpose(0,2,1,3).reshape(B,T,D)
        x = x + o@self.Wo
        h2 = layer_norm(x, self.g2, self.bb2)
        x = x + gelu(h2@self.W1+self.b1)@self.W2+self.b2
        return x

# === GPT-2 MODEL (Stage 4) ===
class MiniGPT2:
    def __init__(self, V, d=48, nh=4, nl=3, ml=48):
        self.d=d; self.ml=ml; self.V=V
        self.te = np.random.randn(V,d)*0.02
        self.pe = np.random.randn(ml,d)*0.02
        self.blocks = [Block(d,nh) for _ in range(nl)]
        self.gf=np.ones(d); self.bf=np.zeros(d)
        self.head = np.random.randn(d,V)*0.02
    def forward(self, ids):
        B,T = ids.shape
        x = self.te[ids] + self.pe[:T][None]
        for b in self.blocks: x = b.forward(x)
        return layer_norm(x, self.gf, self.bf) @ self.head
    def count_params(self):
        t = self.te.size + self.pe.size + self.gf.size + self.bf.size + self.head.size
        for b in self.blocks:
            t += sum(w.size for w in [b.Wq,b.Wk,b.Wv,b.Wo,b.W1,b.b1,b.W2,b.b2,
                                       b.g1,b.bb1,b.g2,b.bb2])
            t += b.lora_q.params() + b.lora_v.params()
        return t

# === Instantiate and verify ===

model = MiniGPT2(tok.vocab_size)

        sc=Q@K.transpose(0,1,3,2)/np.sqrt(self.dk)
        sc+=np.triu(np.ones((T,T))*-1e9,k=1)
        o=(softmax(sc)@V).transpose(0,2,1,3).reshape(B,T,D)
        x=x+o@self.Wo;h2=layer_norm(x,self.g2,self.p2)
        return x+gelu(h2@self.W1+self.b1)@self.W2+self.b2

class G:
    def __init__(self,V,d=48,nh=4,nl=3,ml=48):
        self.d=d;self.ml=ml;self.V=V
        self.te=np.random.randn(V,d)*0.02;self.pe=np.random.randn(ml,d)*0.02
        self.blocks=[BK(d,nh) for _ in range(nl)]
        self.gf=np.ones(d);self.bf=np.zeros(d);self.head=np.random.randn(d,V)*0.02
    def forward(self,ids):
        B,T_=ids.shape;x=self.te[ids]+self.pe[:T_][None]
        for b in self.blocks:x=b.forward(x)
        return layer_norm(x,self.gf,self.bf)@self.head

# === RAG KNOWLEDGE BASE ===
class KnowledgeBase:
    def __init__(self, d=48):
        self.d=d; self.docs=[]; self.embs=[]
    def add(self, text):
        e=np.zeros(self.d)
        for i,c in enumerate(text[:self.d*2]): e[i%self.d]+=ord(c)*0.01
        n=np.linalg.norm(e)
        if n>0: e/=n
        self.docs.append(text); self.embs.append(e)
    def retrieve(self, q, k=2):
        qe=np.zeros(self.d)
        for i,c in enumerate(q[:self.d*2]): qe[i%self.d]+=ord(c)*0.01
        n=np.linalg.norm(qe)
        if n>0: qe/=n
        sims=[np.dot(qe,e) for e in self.embs]
        top=np.argsort(sims)[::-1][:k]
        return [(self.docs[i], sims[i]) for i in top]

# === COMPLETE SYSTEM ===
class CompleteLLMSystem:
    def __init__(self):
        self.tok = T()
        self.model = G(self.tok.vocab_size)
        self.kb = KnowledgeBase()
        for doc in [
            "Attention computes weighted sums using query key value matrices.",
            "LoRA adds low rank matrices A and B to frozen model weights.",
            "RAG retrieves relevant documents to augment the generation context.",
            "Transformers process all tokens in parallel via self-attention.",
            "Fine-tuning adapts a pretrained model to follow instructions.",
            "Cross entropy loss measures next token prediction quality.",
            "BPE tokenizer merges frequent character pairs into subwords.",
            "AdamW combines momentum with decoupled weight decay.",
        ]:
            self.kb.add(doc)

    def generate(self, query, max_new=15, use_rag=True):
        retrieved = self.kb.retrieve(query, k=2) if use_rag else []
        ctx = " ".join(d for d,_ in retrieved)
        prompt = f"Context: {ctx} Query: {query}" if ctx else query
        ids = self.tok.encode(prompt, ml=self.model.ml-max_new)
        gen = list(ids)
        for _ in range(max_new):
            cur = np.array([gen[-self.model.ml:]])
            lo = self.model.forward(cur)[0,-1,:] / 0.8
            ti = np.argsort(lo)[-10:]
            p = softmax(lo[ti])
            gen.append(int(np.random.choice(ti, p=p)))
        pl = len([x for x in ids if x!=0])
        return {'query':query, 'retrieved':retrieved,
                'generated':self.tok.decode(gen[pl:]), 'new_tokens':max_new}

# === RUN END-TO-END ===
system = CompleteLLMSystem()

import numpy as np
np.random.seed(42)

# === Simulate complete system fine-tuning ===

class FineTuningPipeline:
    """Simulates fine-tuning the complete system with LoRA."""

    def __init__(self, d_model=48, n_layers=3, rank=4, alpha=8):
        self.d = d_model
        self.n_layers = n_layers
        # Base model weights (frozen)
        self.base_weights = [np.random.randn(d_model, d_model)*0.02
                             for _ in range(n_layers * 2)]
        # LoRA parameters (trainable)
        self.lora_A = [np.random.randn(d_model, rank)*0.01
                       for _ in range(n_layers * 2)]
        self.lora_B = [np.zeros((rank, d_model))
                       for _ in range(n_layers * 2)]
        self.scaling = alpha / rank
        self.lr = 2e-4

    def forward(self, x):
        h = x
        for i in range(0, len(self.base_weights), 2):
            # Base + LoRA
            w_eff = self.base_weights[i] + self.lora_A[i] @ self.lora_B[i] * self.scaling
            h = np.tanh(h @ w_eff)
        return h

    def train_step(self, x, target):
        output = self.forward(x)
        loss = np.mean((output - target)**2)
        # Simplified gradient update on LoRA only
        for i in range(len(self.lora_A)):
            self.lora_A[i] -= self.lr * np.random.randn(*self.lora_A[i].shape) * loss * 0.01
            self.lora_B[i] -= self.lr * np.random.randn(*self.lora_B[i].shape) * loss * 0.01
        return loss

    def count_params(self):
        base = sum(w.size for w in self.base_weights)
        lora = sum(a.size + b.size for a, b in zip(self.lora_A, self.lora_B))
        return base, lora


# Run fine-tuning

import numpy as np
import time
np.random.seed(42)

class EvaluationSuite:
    def measure_perplexity(self, logits, targets):
        total = 0; n = 0
        for t in range(min(len(targets), logits.shape[0])):
            e = np.exp(logits[t] - np.max(logits[t]))
            p = e / (e.sum() + 1e-8)
            if targets[t] < len(p):
                total += np.log(p[targets[t]] + 1e-10); n += 1
        return min(np.exp(-total/max(n,1)), 10000)

    def measure_relevance(self, query, docs, d=32):
        def emb(t):
            e=np.zeros(d)
            for i,c in enumerate(t.lower()[:d*2]):e[i%d]+=ord(c)*0.01
            n=np.linalg.norm(e); return e/n if n>0 else e
        qe = emb(query)
        scores = [np.dot(qe, emb(doc)) for doc in docs]
        return {'mean': np.mean(scores) if scores else 0,
                'max': np.max(scores) if scores else 0}

    def measure_coherence(self, text):
        words = text.lower().split()
        if len(words) < 2: return {'score': 0}
        bigrams = [(words[i],words[i+1]) for i in range(len(words)-1)]
        bg_div = len(set(bigrams))/max(len(bigrams),1)
        chars = list(text)
        ch_pairs = [(chars[i],chars[i+1]) for i in range(len(chars)-1)]
        ch_div = len(set(ch_pairs))/max(len(ch_pairs),1)
        return {'score': round(bg_div*0.6+ch_div*0.4, 4),
                'bigram_diversity': round(bg_div, 4)}

    def measure_diversity(self, text):
        words = ''.join(c for c in text.lower() if c.isalpha() or c==' ').split()
        if not words: return {'ttr': 0}
        return {'ttr': round(len(set(words))/len(words), 4),
                'unique': len(set(words)), 'total': len(words)}

def softmax(x, axis=-1):
    e=np.exp(x-np.max(x,axis=axis,keepdims=True)); return e/(e.sum(axis=axis,keepdims=True)+1e-8)

    rel = evaluator.measure_relevance(q, r['retrieved'])

    all_results.append({'q':q, 'ppl':ppl, 'rel':rel['mean'],
